newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hanwa Bank depositors to be protected--MOF.
newsitem.headline: Hanwa Bank depositors to be protected--MOF.

text.p: Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said on Thursday that depositors of ailing Hanwa Bank Ltd would be fully protected.
Mitsuzuka said in a statement that the Bank of Japan would supply funds if needed to pay back depositors of Hanwa Bank.
A new bank will be set up to wind up Hanwa Bank, he said.
Mitsuzuka also said that swift handling of failed banks was needed for a recovery in the nation's financial system.
The president of Hanwa Bank, Takeshi Shinkyo, is to resign. Shinkyo is a former Finance Ministry official.
